ayahs.en: By the star when it descends
ayahs.e2: By the stars when they fade away

ayahs.en: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred
ayahs.e2: Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray
ayahs.tr: Maa dalla saahibukum wa maa ghawaa

ayahs.en: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination
ayahs.e2: Nor does he speak of his own whims

ayahs.en: It is not but a revelation revealed
ayahs.e2: It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺

ayahs.en: Taught to him by one intense in strength
ayahs.e2: He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power

ayahs.en: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
ayahs.e2: and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form

ayahs.en: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon
ayahs.e2: while on the highest point above the horizon

ayahs.en: Then he approached and descended
ayahs.e2: then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close

ayahs.en: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer
ayahs.e2: that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less

ayahs.en: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed
ayahs.e2: Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺

ayahs.en: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw
ayahs.e2: The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw
ayahs.tr: Maa kazabal fu'aadu maa ra aa

ayahs.en: So will you dispute with him over what he saw
ayahs.e2: How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw

ayahs.en: And he certainly saw him in another descent
ayahs.e2: And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad ra aahu nazlatan ukhraa

ayahs.en: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary
ayahs.e2: at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—

ayahs.en: Near it is the Garden of Refuge
ayahs.e2: near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—

ayahs.en: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it]
ayahs.e2: while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours

ayahs.en: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit]
ayahs.e2: The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach
ayahs.tr: Maa zaaghal basaru wa maa taghaa

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord
ayahs.e2: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs
ayahs.tr: Laqad ra aa min aayaati Rabbihil kubraaa

ayahs.en: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza
ayahs.e2: Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lât and ’Uzza

ayahs.en: And Manat, the third - the other one
ayahs.e2: and the third one, Manât, as well

ayahs.en: Is the male for you and for Him the female
ayahs.e2: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters

ayahs.en: That, then, is an unjust division
ayahs.e2: Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution

ayahs.ar: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءࣱ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance
ayahs.e2: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord
ayahs.tr: In hiya illaaa asmaaa'un sammaitumoohaaa antum wa aabaaa'ukum maaa anzalal laahu bihaa min sultaan; inyyattabi'oona illaz zanna wa maa tahwal anfusu wa laqad jaaa'ahum mir Rabbihimul hudaa

ayahs.en: Or is there for man whatever he wishes
ayahs.e2: Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire
ayahs.tr: Am lil insaani maa taman naa

ayahs.en: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]
ayahs.e2: In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next

ayahs.ar: ۞وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكࣲ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves
ayahs.e2: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves
ayahs.tr: Wa kam mim malakin fissamaawaati laa tughnee shafaa'atuhum shai'an illaa mim ba'di anyyaazanal laahu limany yashaaa'u wa yardaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names
ayahs.e2: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female
ayahs.tr: innal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati la yusammoonal malaaa'ikata tasmiyatal unsaa

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.en: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all
ayahs.e2: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth
ayahs.tr: Wa maa lahum bihee min 'ilmin iny yattabi'oona illaz zanna wa innaz zanna laa yughnee minal haqqi shai'aa

ayahs.ar: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
ayahs.en: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life
ayahs.e2: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world
ayahs.tr: Fa a'rid 'am man tawallaa 'an zikrinaa wa lam yurid illal hayaatad dunyaa

ayahs.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
ayahs.en: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided
ayahs.e2: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
ayahs.tr: Zalika mablaghuhum minal 'ilm; inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabee lihee wa huwa a'lamu bimanih tadaa

ayahs.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى
ayahs.en: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward]
ayahs.e2: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—
ayahs.tr: Wa lillaahi maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi liyajziyal lazeena asaaa'oo bimaa 'amiloo wa yajziyal lazeena ahsanoo bilhusnaa

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةࣱ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him
ayahs.e2: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth and while you were ˹still˺ fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous
ayahs.tr: Allazeena yajtaniboona kabaaa'iral ismi walfawaa hisha illal lamam; inna rabbaka waasi'ul maghfirah; huwa a'lamu bikum iz ansha akum minal ardi wa iz antum ajinnatun fee butooni umma haatikum falaa tuzakkooo anfusakum huwa a'lamu bimanit taqaa

ayahs.en: Have you seen the one who turned away
ayahs.e2: Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺

ayahs.en: And gave a little and [then] refrained
ayahs.e2: and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped

ayahs.en: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees
ayahs.e2: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
ayahs.e2: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses
ayahs.tr: Am lam yunabbaa bimaa fee suhuhfi Moosa

ayahs.en: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations]
ayahs.e2: and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺

ayahs.en: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
ayahs.e2: ˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another

ayahs.ar: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.en: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
ayahs.e2: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards
ayahs.tr: Wa al laisa lil insaani illaa maa sa'aa

ayahs.en: And that his effort is going to be seen
ayahs.e2: and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺

ayahs.en: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
ayahs.e2: then they will be fully rewarded

ayahs.en: And that to your Lord is the finality
ayahs.e2: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺

ayahs.en: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
ayahs.e2: Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness
ayahs.tr: Wa annahoo huwa adhaka wa abkaa

ayahs.en: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
ayahs.e2: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death
ayahs.tr: Wa annahoo huwa amaata wa ahyaa

ayahs.en: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female
ayahs.e2: And He created the pairs—males and females—
ayahs.tr: Wa annahoo khalaqaz zawjainiz zakara wal unsaa

ayahs.en: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
ayahs.e2: from a sperm-drop when it is emitted

ayahs.en: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
ayahs.e2: And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation

ayahs.en: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
ayahs.e2: And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes
ayahs.tr: Wa annahoo huwa aghnaa wa aqnaa

ayahs.en: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
ayahs.e2: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius

ayahs.en: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
ayahs.e2: And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd

ayahs.en: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them]
ayahs.e2: and ˹then˺ Thamûd, sparing no one

ayahs.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
ayahs.en: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing
ayahs.e2: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression
ayahs.tr: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaanoo hum azlama wa atghaa

ayahs.en: And the overturned towns He hurled down
ayahs.e2: And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down

ayahs.en: And covered them by that which He covered
ayahs.e2: How overwhelming was what covered ˹them˺

ayahs.en: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt
ayahs.e2: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute

ayahs.en: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners
ayahs.e2: This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones

ayahs.en: The Approaching Day has approached
ayahs.e2: The approaching ˹Hour˺ has drawn near

ayahs.ar: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
ayahs.en: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover
ayahs.e2: None but Allah can disclose it
ayahs.tr: Laisa lahaa min doonil laahi kaashifah

ayahs.en: Then at this statement do you wonder
ayahs.e2: Do you find this revelation astonishing

ayahs.en: And you laugh and do not weep
ayahs.e2: laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺

ayahs.en: While you are proudly sporting
ayahs.e2: while persisting in heedlessness

ayahs.en: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him]
ayahs.e2: Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺
